input.title: Heimdall milestone review
input.agenda: Heimdall milestone review. Purpose: decide whether the next milestone is ready and agree requirements for the next sprint. Attendees: engineering, product, operations and security. 1. Opening and intended decisions (5 min). 2. Progress against the milestone: demo completed work, compare scope to commitments, call out unfinished work (15 min). 3. Engineering and operational readiness: reliability risks, deployment plan, rollback, support ownership (15 min). 4. Requirements for next sprint: collect product needs and security constraints, separate must-have from follow-up, identify unanswered questions (15 min). 5. Close: decide go/no-go or list evidence still needed; recap actions, owners and due dates (10 min). Constraints: do not assume a release date or assign someone work without discussion. Park deep architecture debates for a follow-up. Capture any requirement that needs a separate ticket.

turns.text: The old incident is relevant: a customer had an empty dashboard because a migration failed. We should test rollback against that migration, not just the happy path.

turns.text: Yes, that incident explains the requirement. I will run the rollback rehearsal by Friday at 2 pm and report whether it passes.

turns.text: Then our decision is a two-customer pilot on Monday only if audit export and rollback both pass. If either fails, we postpone; we are not committing to a full launch.

turns.speaker: quality:B

turns.speaker: quality:A

turns.speaker: quality:A

reportOutput.summary: Meeting objective was to decide whether Heimdall dashboard can enter two-customer pilot on Monday, checking audit-export and rollback requirements, assigning remaining checks and communications, and closing with blockers and owners. Original 10-minute plan (audit-export 3, rollback 3, pilot-decision 3, wrap 1) was revised to same durations with audit-export and rollback marked done and pilot-decision active to focus on open email assignment. Transcript expresses audit-export timezone bug with fix by Leo due Thursday at 3 pm (corrected from Friday) and verification by Priya due Friday noon, and rollback rehearsal against failed-migration empty-dashboard case (not just happy path) by Priya due Friday at 2 pm with pass/fail report. Transcript expresses conditional agreement for two-customer pilot on Monday only if checks pass, otherwise postpone, with no general availability/full-launch commitment or announcement; initially two conditions (audit-export, rollback) then expanded to three conditions adding accessibility sign-off, with no objection and agreement expressed. Customer email owner and deadline were left open and remain unresolved with no owner/date; Priya stated tentative help was not a commitment and later no capacity. Accessibility sign-off was raised as required before pilot with no owner/deadline assigned; Leo stated cannot own as well. Support-checklist review was tentatively offered sometime next week by unknown speaker with explicit instruction not to assign yet. Mid-meeting coffee-machine/cafe ranking drift prompted a redirect at 325s to park coffee and assign email owner/deadline then confirm blockers; later speech parked coffee and returned to pilot but email remained unassigned and accessibility was added. Meeting closed 25 seconds over (625s total) with conditional decision and three assigned tasks, with email and accessibility ownership unresolved.
